note: Variety in the fights of the open world (core/game/game_variety.gd): elite foes, attack patterns and the phases of a legend. Every RULE here applies only to a fight with `variety` on (GameDynasty.start_encounter given variety keys, and a dungeon's legend): hunts, hunt-board legends and everything the autopilot or the golden scenarios play never read it, so they play exactly as before. Every roll is a keyed hash of the dynasty's seed, the tile or place and the creature, never the dynasty's dice. Mods: `name` is the prefix; hp, atk, def, agi are multipliers; `reward` multiplies xp and gold; `taken` multiplies the damage the foe takes; `drain` is the share of the damage it deals that it heals; `rage` raises its blows by up to that share as its health falls; `lead` raises every other foe's blows by that share while it stands; `pack_only` mods are given only by the pack-leader roll. Patterns: `every` is the cycle in rounds (at least 3, so a telegraph comes first). heavy: a blow of `mult` times, announced the round before (wind_up). brace: the foe spends its turn bracing and takes `taken` times the damage until its next turn. call: below `below` of its health the foe calls for help (announced, then `count` kin arrive the next round) once a fight.
